description: Test suite for sandbox tool policy functions using Vitest framework, verifying policy merging, allow/deny semantics, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: pickSandboxToolPolicy
methods.description: Determines the effective sandbox tool policy based on configuration inputs, merging allow and alsoAllow settings, and handling deny rules.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolPolicy
methods.description: Resolves the overall effective tool policy, considering global and profile-specific configurations.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveToolFsRootExpansionAllowed
methods.description: Determines if file system root expansion is allowed based on configuration settings.

ctags.name: resolved
ctags.pattern: /^    const resolved = resolveEffectiveToolPolicy({ config: cfg, agentId: "main" });$/
